title: finding(scripts/pm): check-harness-current still prescribes "close the shift and re-seat" — the remedy #18476 replaced with a seat-post reading
body:
`check-harness-current.mjs`'s verdict line still prescribes the remedy **#18476 replaced**. A seat that reads it will close a shift the charter no longer asks it to close — which is the exact cost #18476 was written to remove.

## The two texts, quoted

**The guard says** (`scripts/pm/check-harness-current.mjs`, STALE verdict line, read on `origin/main` `fed4a15`):

```
check-harness-current: STALE -- 2 harness-loaded path(s) on origin/main are not in
/home/user/objectstack HEAD 85c6d76ec4: close the shift and re-seat in a fresh session;
⛔ never advance the shared checkout in place
```

**The charter says** (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, the 开轮互斥 block, since `d3c8116` / #18476):

> - 否 ⇒ **记座位贴,自然收班时换会话,⛔ 不中断批次**;读数走 `scripts/pm/check-harness-current.mjs`。

⇒ the guard names 「close the shift and re-seat」; the rule it exists to serve names 「记座位贴…⛔ 不中断批次」. **They disagree**, and the guard is the text a seat actually sees at the moment it has to decide.

## Why this is worth a card rather than a shrug

⭐ **The cost is exactly the one #18476 removed.** That PR's own title — 「drop the re-seat prescription — check-harness-current and SKILL.md:92 become a seat-post reading」 — names **both halves**, and only the SKILL.md half landed. Before it, **five consecutive triage shifts** closed on this reading; the whole point of the change was that they should not have had to.

⚠️ **And the guard's wording is more authoritative-looking than the charter's**, because it arrives as a machine verdict at the decision point rather than as a line in an 800-line document. A seat following it is not being careless — it is following the more specific instruction in front of it.

## Measured, this fire

The triage seat hit STALE at {{WAS:2026-09-16T16:58Z}} (cause: **#18478** removed `.claude/hooks/guard-governed-enqueue.sh` + its selftest and changed `.claude/settings.json`), read **both** texts, and continued per the charter — ⛔ it did not close the shift. That is the first exercise of the new rule, and it required knowing the guard's line was stale. **The next seat may not.**

## ⛔ What this card does not assert

- ⛔ **Not a claim that the guard's DETECTION is wrong.** The STALE verdict was correct and useful; only the prescribed remedy is out of date.
- ⛔ **Not a proposal to remove the line.** A verdict line that says nothing about what to do is worse than one that is stale. The repair is presumably to point at the seat-post reading instead — but ⛔ the wording is the skills seat's call, ⛔ not this filer's.
- ⛔ **No other caller audited.** Whether anything else (a hook, a workflow, another reference file) repeats the old prescription was **NOT MEASURED**. ⚠️ Worth one grep before the fix is scoped — a second copy would fail the same way.
